name: 15104 · Braddock, PA
findings: ZIP 15104 (Braddock) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15104 (Braddock) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 15104 (Braddock) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
